task_description: Run once at game start or at a chosen time during the game, enabling or disabling selected challenges in a batch. Disabling also closes their containers. Pending tasks catch up after a restart if the game is still running.
blackout_description: Block all flag and choice submissions and container creation/renewal; close existing game containers. Supports one-off dates and daily periods, including overnight periods. Overlapping periods remain blocked until all end; only applies within game time. Containers are not restarted automatically.

notify_description: Published as a contest announcement. For QQ delivery, enable Napcat and select the contest announcement event under Message push.

default_blackout_message: Outside competition hours. Submissions are paused and existing containers will be closed.
delete_confirm: Delete this rule? Changes already executed will be preserved.
blocked_description: Answering is temporarily unavailable. Containers are closed. Access resumes automatically when the blackout ends.
